_comment: Native connector coverage registry. Must equal core/conan/coverage.cpp (tests/drift_test.py). 'status' is evidence (live-supported needs MCP plus client evidence); 'implementation' says whether native code exists ('native') or the action still answers a structured not-ported error ('pending').

statusLegend.live-supported: Native code exists and was proven live through Takaro with MCP and client evidence.
statusLegend.schema-fallback: Answers the schema-valid empty DTO Takaro requires because the data does not exist for this game.
statusLegend.unsupported: Answers a structured error because neither the game nor Takaro can back it.
statusLegend.pending: Native code is missing or not yet proven live; transitional, must be gone before release.

getPlayer.responseShape: public Takaro player DTO or null
getPlayer.verification: MCP gameserverGetPlayers then the player, with the client online
getPlayer.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: PlayerArray -> PlayerState -> controller (read path proven in stage 1).

getPlayers.verification: MCP gameserverGetPlayers with the client online
getPlayers.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: PlayerArray -> PlayerState -> controller, plus ping and IP.

getPlayerLocation.responseShape: { x: number, y: number, z: number }
getPlayerLocation.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: K2_GetActorLocation through ProcessEvent.

getPlayerInventory.verification: MCP inventory vs the client inventory screen
getPlayerInventory.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: UItemInventory by reflection (no sqlite).

giveItem.verification: MCP gameserverGiveItem plus the stack in the client inventory
giveItem.reason: ItemInventory.AddItemTemplate on ConanCharacter.GetBackpackInventory, one stack per call, looped until the amount is given and read back with GetNumberOfItemsByTemplate. The item code is a template id or an ItemNameToTemplateID row name; unknown codes are refused. Quality is ignored (Conan items have no quality tier). Not proven live yet.

listItems.responseShape: Takaro item DTO array with display names
listItems.verification: MCP sample has display names and zero class names
listItems.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: ItemTable rows with localized names.

listEntities.responseShape: Takaro entity DTO array with display names
listEntities.verification: MCP sample has display names and zero class names
listEntities.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: class walk with a humaniser.

listLocations.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback.

executeConsoleCommand.reason: KismetSystemLibrary.ExecuteConsoleCommand in the first online player's console with the admin flag set and restored inside one game-thread job (the engine console when nobody is online). rawResult = the server log lines of that frame (Conan commands answer through the log). exit/quit and the RCON verbs (listplayers, kickplayer, banplayer, unbanplayer, listbans, broadcast, shutdown) are refused with the Takaro action to use. Not proven live yet.

sendMessage.verification: Live 2026-10-03 on rig 349 (bridge stopped): MCP gameserverSendMessage global and directed (opts.recipient.gameId + senderNameOverride) -> native log delivered=1 each, both lines in the client chat (El-Limon evidence native-stage2/L1)
sendMessage.reason: ClientReceiveChatMessage on each online ConanPlayerController through ProcessEvent on the game thread; global, or directed by Steam64 / character name.

teleportPlayer.verification: MCP gameserverTeleportPlayer plus the client position
teleportPlayer.reason: ConanPlayerController.TeleportPlayerServer (RunCheatCheck=false, SnapToGround=true), Conan's own teleport with area streaming; read back with K2_GetActorLocation (x/y within 300 units; z snaps to the ground). Not proven live yet.

testReachability.verification: Live 2026-10-03: MCP gameserverTestReachabilityForId -> {connectable:true, reason:null} from the native library with the bridge stopped; unknown-build path covered by tests/so_test.py
testReachability.reason: In-process: connectable when the server build is pinned and the ProcessEvent hook is installed; an unknown build answers connectable=false with the reason.

kickPlayer.reason: PlayerController.ClientReturnToMainMenuWithTextReason with the reason (FText from KismetTextLibrary.Conv_StringToText); succeeds only once the player has left the online list. Not proven live yet.

banPlayer.reason: Connector ban list keyed by Steam64 in Saved/Config/Takaro/bans.json (atomic write), online and offline, permanent or timed (expiresAt); enforced by a kick at K2_PostLogin and a sweep over the online players. Conan's own blacklist cannot hold offline or timed bans and is not touched. Not proven live yet.

unbanPlayer.reason: Removes the Steam64 from the connector ban list (works offline). Timed bans are lifted by the connector itself at expiry. Not proven live yet.

listBans.reason: The active entries of the connector ban list with player, reason and expiresAt. Not proven live yet.

shutdown.verification: countdown in the client plus process exit
shutdown.reason: Answers first, then a chat countdown (TAKARO_CONAN_SHUTDOWN_SECONDS, default 60), then the engine's graceful exit through KismetSystemLibrary.ExecuteConsoleCommand("exit") -> UGameEngine::HandleExitCommand -> FUnixPlatformMisc::RequestExit. No signature pin. Not proven live yet.

getMapInfo.responseShape: { enabled: false, mapBlockSize: 0, maxZoom: 0, mapSizeX: 0, mapSizeY: 0, mapSizeZ: 0 }
getMapInfo.reason: Hosted Takaro shows no map tiles for Generic servers; answers the disabled MapInfo DTO Takaro validates.

getMapTile.verification: MCP gameserverGetMapTile returns the structured error
getMapTile.reason: Hosted Takaro shows no map tiles for Generic servers; no tile renderer exists for Conan.

player-connected.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); nothing is emitted for it. Planned: K2_PostLogin or a PlayerArray diff.

player-disconnected.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); nothing is emitted for it. Planned: K2_OnLogout or a PlayerArray diff.

chat-message.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); nothing is emitted for it. Planned: ServerSendChatMessage in the detour (proven hook point).

player-death.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); nothing is emitted for it.

entity-killed.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); nothing is emitted for it.

log.reason: Today only the connector's own critical notices (an unsupported server build) are sent as log events; the in-process server log tail is Phase 2.
